lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Cloud Nine Logistics! Every delivery in the realm routes through this sky-hub. Including, nine years ago, my birthday present.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: We're here to save the kingdom's supply lines. But if we HAPPEN to find a small box addressed to Pip... we take it.

lines.speaker: Sorting Sphinx
lines.text: ANSWER MY RIDDLE OR BE MISROUTED: What has four digits, defines your fate, and nobody remembers theirs?

lines.speaker: Sorting Sphinx
lines.text: CORRECT. UNFORTUNATELY I AM STILL CONTRACTUALLY REQUIRED TO FIGHT YOU.
The Dead Letter Office. Paper slips swirl like snow. Something vast breathes beneath them.

lines.speaker: FINAL NOTICE
lines.text: WE ATTEMPTED DELIVERY. YOU. WERE. HOME.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: I heard the knock! I ran to the door in eight seconds!

lines.speaker: FINAL NOTICE
lines.text: EIGHT SECONDS IS AN ETERNITY. PREPARE FOR REDELIVERY.
Nine years of parcels rain gently from the sky. Somewhere, everyone's missing left glove comes home.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: MY BIRTHDAY PRESENT! It's... a smaller box. Addressed to me. From me. "Do not open until the finale." PIP, YOU ABSOLUTE MYSTERY.
